patch_description:
This revision combines the low-lag adaptive Kalman tracker from the strongest prior implementation with three causal endpoint-aligned weighted linear regressions. The regression bank provides stable, medium, and recent local trend estimates without adding phase delay beyond the required trailing-window alignment.

The filter confidence-blends the Kalman estimate with the multi-scale regression estimate: stable fits dominate in noisy or estimator-disagreement regions, while the recent endpoint fit receives more weight only when all slope estimates agree. A predictive alpha-beta consensus stage preserves responsiveness. Finally, an adaptive hysteresis controller suppresses low-amplitude and one-sample opposite-direction movements, reducing false reversals and slope changes while allowing strong or persistent genuine turns through quickly.

All public functions, arguments, validation behavior, and output alignment are preserved.
